title: Global Logistics Fleet Connectivity
business: A multinational logistics firm managing a fleet of autonomous delivery drones across diverse international territories.
problem: The firm faces routing failures when drones transition between regional cellular networks, as dynamic IP address assignments cause session drops in the central command-and-control server.
solution: Implementing static IP addressing for each drone interface ensures that the central routing table maintains a persistent mapping, allowing the network layer to reliably deliver packets across interconnected networks regardless of the underlying physical access point.
steps: Provision a dedicated subnet for the fleet within the regional gateway.
Assign a unique static IP address to each drone network interface controller.
Configure the central router to recognize these static addresses for packet destination matching.
Verify routing table updates to ensure packets are directed to the correct gateway interface.
outcome: Improved session persistence and reduced packet loss during network handovers, leading to more stable drone telemetry streams.
limitation: Static IP addressing creates an administrative burden and potential address exhaustion; verify this by checking the subnet occupancy rate against the total available address pool.

questions.question: In Global Logistics Fleet Connectivity, why is static IP addressing used?
options: To increase the physical speed of the drone hardware.
To prevent session drops caused by dynamic IP assignment during network transitions.
To reduce the cost of cellular data plans.
To allow drones to communicate without a central server.
questions.explanation: Static IPs provide a persistent mapping that prevents the connection issues inherent in dynamic assignment during network handovers.
questions.evidence: The firm faces routing failures when drones transition between regional cellular networks, as dynamic IP address assignments cause session drops in the central command-and-control server.

questions.question: In Global Logistics Fleet Connectivity, what is a primary limitation of the solution?
options: It requires expensive specialized hardware for every drone.
It increases the latency of every packet sent.
It creates administrative overhead and risks address exhaustion.
It prevents the drones from using encryption.
questions.explanation: Static IP management is manually intensive and can lead to running out of available addresses in a subnet.
